QUOTE: The "two places" are two functions in `LlamaCppTokenizer` (`src/inference/llama_cpp_tokenizer.cpp`), each making two llama.cpp calls. ... `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` (lines 49–71) calls `llama_tokenize` once with a null buffer and size 0 ... then calls `llama_tokenize` again to fill it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the file and identifies the two-call size-probe-then-fill pattern in tokenize (and the resize-retry in detokenize) with line ranges.
